label: Shortest paths with node costs
subgoals: Seed the queue with the source's reachable wires at their own cost
Pop the cheapest wire and relax its neighbors by adding their cost
Stop when a wire reaching the sink is popped

label: Routing multi-sink nets
subgoals: Route the first sink by a full wavefront search
Add its path to the tree at zero cost
Search from the whole tree for the next sink

label: Directed search
subgoals: Estimate the remaining cost from distance and the cheapest wire cost
Order the queue by g plus alpha times h
Expand the node with the smallest f
